source_sensitivity.limits: Source-ID sensitivity on existing development scores, not fresh inference or a new scene-independent test. Fixed cohorts selected from content/metadata after historical4k review but before original20k full427 scoring. Unknown aliases, ancestor-model/foundation pretraining exposure and training/selection uncertainty remain unmeasured. Classical bounds/observation metadata and all original427 results are retained. No quality promotion or native-pixel review is supplied by these statistics.

hue_limitations: One observation per grid cell, one WB/camera, three brightnesses/two saturations; scene-linear HSV, not perceptually uniform. Clean targets stay below white; noisy ADC can clip. Descriptive quantiles are not confidence intervals. Not training-repeat uncertainty, real-photo quality, convergence, cause or SOTA evidence.

primary.limits: Threshold application only, using the separate primary coverage/arithmetic review. Does not recompute predictions, metrics or bootstrap intervals. Source/scene intervals do not estimate training-seed uncertainty. Canonical camera-linear scores retain the original target convention. Numerical passes alone cannot authorize full-frame integration, promotion or establish SOTA/100MP10s.

high_noise_weak_carriers.scope: Two predeclared carrier/flat contrasts after full1344-case scalar coverage/arithmetic audit. Signed coherent gain and unrelated error remain separate. Descriptive analytic means are not photographic or training-seed uncertainty; manual native review remains required.

analytic.scope: Full analytic coverage/arithmetic first. Two high-noise gain/flat contrasts and all192 ADC layout/draw cases; retain12 group means. These descriptive fixtures do not establish photo quality or training-seed uncertainty.

manual_review.view_method: view_image detail=original on all eight final board sources; packaged copies are byte-identical. Also viewed four fresh-only boards and twelve primary GFX source triplets before reading final quality metrics. No resize or strict blinding claim.

notes_by_panel.full427: All methods remain close in the fixed exact-GT examples. Fine paraglider cords/wing lines are largely suppressed and cloud/facade detail is softened; no clear added-native-data detail gain is visible.
notes_by_panel.known: Plate variation stays softened; the thin light fiber and isolated chart points remain. Current models look close. RawNIND boundaries look softer/fringed in these few patches; no whole-image superiority follows.
notes_by_panel.unseen: Brown object/illustration structure is restored with similar smoothness across current checkpoints. The independent AHD reference retains more variation. These fixed regions do not establish broad real-camera superiority.
notes_by_panel.gfx: Sky noise is suppressed. V63, V84, V85 and V43 look close in building, foliage and fence detail. Fine building wires and leaves remain soft. Fence diamonds are more continuous than RawNIND broken/checkered detail, while foliage still lacks a clear improvement. ISO100 differs in aperture/time/motion and is not exact GT.
notes_by_panel.analytic: The dark high-noise carrier is almost entirely suppressed; the brighter period16 carrier is only weakly retained. Displayed flat fields show no obvious new pattern. The numerical ADC regression remains an adverse result.
notes_by_panel.hue: Both new arms reduce the parent bright-magenta mottling in this fixed palette. No conspicuous new color failure appears in these displayed patches; fixed-grid descriptive bias/RMS remain required and do not establish real-photo color accuracy.
notes_by_panel.hue-extra: The four additional fixed hue/saturation/brightness patches look close across the new arms. Small smooth residual variation remains; this finite RGB8 view cannot rule out numerical bias.
notes_by_panel.highlights: Fine cyan/blue neon-wave detail remains unresolved in all three predictions. Broad sign/platform geometry looks similar. ISO100 AHD differs in exposure, aperture, motion and sign content; no pixelwise highlight score is assigned.

quality_decision.reason: No positive matched photo interval from added native data; both arms fail known-CFA eligibility; both weak-carrier gain gates fail and four ADC layout/draw cases regress beyond the fixed ceiling.

manual_review.limits: Actual viewing covers fixed native RGB8 previews only, with independently demosaiced real references labeled accurately. It cannot exclude other failures, override adverse numerical tests, establish whole-image superiority or satisfy the global SOTA/100MP10s goal.
